record.question: Cockpit of Europe
record.explanation: Answer B: Belgium. Belgium is the country historically called the Cockpit of Europe, a reference to repeated wars fought there. The original First World War regimental narrative The Seventh Manchesters explicitly uses the epithet for Belgium. Historical/source note: Historical military-geographical nickname, not an official modern country designation. Reference: https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/18659/pg18659-images.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
